programmes.department: Division of Management Sciences and Marketing
programmes.evidence: The official PhD Business and Management programme description explicitly links doctoral research within the Division of Management Sciences and Marketing and lists operations and supply chain management among its doctoral research themes. The separately opened division page confirms the exact named unit and its doctoral opportunities. This is one broad doctorate hosted in a Management Sciences division, not a separately awarded Operations specialization.
limitations: Operations and supply chain management is described as a doctoral research theme, not a separately awarded degree or formal concentration. The named Management Sciences division supplies the qualifying unit-title evidence.
Other business and engineering doctoral routes remain unchecked; no individual graduate degree or historical continuity is inferred.

branches.conclusion: One current Business and Management PhD pathway in the explicitly named Management Sciences and Marketing division is verified; operations and supply-chain management is a stated doctoral research theme. Wider doctoral coverage remains incomplete.
No engineering doctoral inventory reviewed in this proposal; no absence or extra route inferred.
